title: Viewing your logbook
description: Browse your full history in one place.

steps.text: Open the Log tab to see all entries newest-first.
Filter by type — trips, fills, services, notes.
Tap an entry to see details.
Export the logbook as a PDF for a copy.

tips: The logbook rides along in your data backup.
Use it to spot patterns ahead of the season.
affects: Season stats, Year in Review, and the fuel-range brain.
examples: Scanning what you did last season.
Exporting the logbook PDF for a buyer.
